days.name: Monday · Observe & Ask
days.lesson: Introduce **Final Measurement Mission**. Strong weather observers measure carefully, organize data, explain patterns, and act safely.
days.lab: Complete a station review using instruments, graphs, forecasts, and safety decisions.
worksheet: Write or draw what you already notice about final measurement mission.
Record one observation related to time-stamped observations, counts, categories, or measurements.
Write one question you want to answer this week.

days.name: Tuesday · Measure & Record
days.lesson: Scientists make fair comparisons by recording the same kind of evidence. This week, focus on time-stamped observations, counts, categories, or measurements.
days.lab: Repeat or extend the week's investigation: Complete a station review using instruments, graphs, forecasts, and safety decisions. Record at least two observations or measurements.
worksheet: Create a small data table with labels and units or categories.
Circle the largest change or most important difference.
Write one sentence describing what the data show.

days.name: Wednesday · Model & Explain
days.lesson: Use a model, diagram, or sequence to explain the idea: Strong weather observers measure carefully, organize data, explain patterns, and act safely.
days.lab: Build, draw, or revise a model of final measurement mission using the week's evidence.
worksheet: Label your model with at least two of these words: weather, measurement, measure.
Draw arrows or numbers to show change, motion, or order when appropriate.
Explain one way the model is similar to real weather and one way it is different.

days.name: Thursday · Apply & Explore
days.lesson: Connect final measurement mission to a real forecast, weather map, local observation, or Solanar learning tool.
days.lab: Use **Elementary Weather Portal** or a teacher-provided weather source to find one example connected to this week's topic.
worksheet: Write the place, date/time, and source you used.
Record one piece of evidence from the source.
Explain how the evidence connects to this week's concept.

days.name: Friday · Communicate & Master
days.lesson: Review the week's evidence and communicate a clear scientific explanation of final measurement mission.
days.lab: Create a 60-second weather-science briefing, mini-poster, diagram, or demonstration using this week's evidence.
worksheet: Complete: My strongest evidence this week was…
Complete: I used this evidence to explain…
Complete the weekly mastery quiz. Score 80% or higher to open the next week.
